1. ORIENTATION: laid flat (54 x 4 x 7 mm)
2. THINNEST WALL, WHOLE SOLID (RAY MINIMUM): 0.9210 mm — a distance through
material, NOT a printable wall where it falls on an edge, a fillet run-out
or a chamfer tip. Printability is judged on the next line.
3. PRINTABLE MINIMUM WALL: 0.9236 mm (smallest median wall over a 1.1100 mm

4. 2 horizontal bore(s) bridge at the crown: ream any bearing or press-fit
6. TOLERANCE BASIS, IN-HOUSE: CANNOT DETERMINE. Every Bambu on this farm
records tolerance_mm: null, cite "no coupon printed and measured on this
2026-09-02), and Bambu Lab's own H2D Pro spec sheet carries no
dimensional-accuracy line. DIMENSIONS HERE ARE NOMINAL AS MODELLED.
7. TOLERANCE BASIS, OUTSOURCED: JLC3DP ±0.3 mm FDM (jlc3dp.com,
ce-machines/farm-hubs). Apply the route's figure, not both. The ±0.2 mm in
cecad/machining.py fdm is a repo planning constant with no vendor cite and
is NOT used here. One printed and measured coupon closes this note.
8. NO ISO 286 CLASS IS DECLARED ON ANY BORE: FDM cannot be sized to one
(H7/p6 at Ø3 is a 0.010 mm band). REAM bearing and press-fit bores after
9. RADII NAMED IN cad/part.py THAT ARE NOT CIRCULAR EDGES ON THIS SOLID:
1.00 mm, 2.00 mm. cecad.inspect.arc_radii measures 1 ARC(S) HERE AND EVERY
ONE IS DIMENSIONED ABOVE. NO DIMENSION IS MISSING: A LEADER NEEDS AN EDGE.
THE GEOMETRY FILE CARRIES THE SURFACE.

CANNOT DETERMINE — FEATURES THIS CENSUS COULD NOT MEASURE (A4)
CANNOT DETERMINE — CHAMFER: A4 requires size and angle on every chamfer;
cecad.inspect has no chamfer classifier — a chamfer is a planar face
bridging two faces at an angle and nothing here identifies one. SETTLED BY:
a chamfer classifier in cecad.inspect (planar face whose two neighbours
meet it at equal angles), or the builder declaring its chamfers in the part
CANNOT DETERMINE — RIB: A4 requires thickness, height and pitch on every
rib; nothing here groups faces into a rib. SETTLED BY: a rib classifier
(parallel thin prisms standing off a wall), or the builder declaring its
CANNOT DETERMINE — DRAFT: A4 requires every draft angle; no face here is
tested for draft against a pull direction. SETTLED BY: a pull direction on
the part record, then the angle of every planar face to it
CANNOT DETERMINE — STEP: A4 requires every step and shoulder; nothing here
classifies a shoulder between two coaxial diameters or two parallel faces.
SETTLED BY: a step classifier, or the section views declaring their
CANNOT DETERMINE — MATE: A4 requires every surface that mates with another
part, with the mating part named by its triad ref; the mates live in
ce-assemblies/*/joints.json and are not read here. SETTLED BY: reading this
part's joints out of the assemblies that use it and matching each mate to a
CANNOT DETERMINE — WALL: A4 wants a wall thickness at every distinct
station; only the thinnest wall is measurable off the solid without a
station list. SETTLED BY: the drawer declaring the section stations it
dimensions, or a section per shell region
